verdicts.reason: Both are shrink-and-spread copies: the lantern and cloud clusters are scaled down and pushed to the far edges, leaving big empty yellow gaps either side of a tiny central SALE column whose tassel almost touches the bottom edge, so at banner size the message is weak. A's larger 'NEW YEAR SPECIAL' headline holds the hierarchy a bit better, even though it sits tight above the 'S' circle. B's headline is shrunk to small text and the column feels even more lost.
